name: My Little Dog Adventure
descr: 关于此游戏In My Little Dog Adventure you play as a little dog that discovers the world on its mission to find its way back home.It's a short emotional story-driven exploration game that will keep you interested with an immersive story and lovable characters.What to expect?A sweet little story about a lovable dog and friendshipStory-driven gameplay and puzzle elementsChanging perspectives in storytelling and gameplaySeveral huge environments are waiting to be exploredMany secrets that are hidden and are waiting to be discoveredExperience the world as a dogBecome friends with other animalsA lot of fun and emotions are waiting for you
